reason: An offline macOS plugin that exposes an OCR tool for extracting text from screenshots, scans, and document images using Apple Vision, with local filesystem access and a compiled native helper.

summaries.zh: 这是一个基于 macOS Apple Vision 的离线 OCR 插件，可从截图、扫描件和文档图片中提取文字并提供给模型。
summaries.en: An offline macOS OCR plugin that uses Apple Vision to extract text from screenshots, scans, and document images for model use.

capabilities: Extracts text from user-specified image files using macOS Vision OCR
Reads image paths through the host filesystem service
Compiles and executes a local Swift helper through the host subprocess service
Places recognized text into the session transcript and model context
